summary: A roblox game that gives informs players about the twin mars rovers Spirit and Opportunity. This is meant to give players an introduction to the world of space and science, through a medium that most kids use.
details: It's a simply roblox game where you retrieve the wreakage of the Rovers: Spirit and opportunity. We made the game so that the kids would have a gateway into the world of space and science, while also trying to balance the rules of the hackathon and making sure to add information from the resources given to us. We wanted to create a creative way to consume information without getting bored, we also wanted to complete the challenge and have a story aspect to the game, and finally we wanted to tie it all together with an enganing medium.
dataRefs: Mars Exploration Rovers: Spirit and Opportunity
